out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. PIC WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE PROCEDURES AS INDICATED ABOVE.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: PROCEDURES PROVIDED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: OBSERVED KIDS CUPS NOT BEING SANITIZED IN PLAIN BLEACH.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: CUPS WERE PROPERLY WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED WITH ~50PPM BLEACH.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Availability of Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There are no chemical sanitizers for sanitizing equipment and utensils available in the establishment. OBSERVED ONLY CLOROX: SANITIZER + CLEANER AT FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: Except for those that are generated on-site, at the time of use, chemical sanitizers that are used to sanitize equipment and utensils shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. CDI: WORKER WENT TO THE STORE DURING INSPECTION AND PURCHASED PLAIN BLEACH. EHS RE-EDUCATED STAFF ON PURCHASING PLAIN SANITIZER.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: EHS did not observe a written employee health policy available during the time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. EHS provided a copy of the employee health policy to PIC and PICV had all employees read agree and sign the policy.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the Bleach solution was measured 200+ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of bleach solution at 50-200 ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. PIC tested all sanitizer to verify correct solution.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of various dry snacks.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC reviewed single use container use with EHS agreed to acquire new reusable containers.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device Used to Check Sanitizer Conc
violations.observation: EHS observed test kit was not being used to check for sanitizer concentration when sanitizer was made.
violations.corrective_action: The operator shall be monitoring the concentration of the sanitizing solution using a test kit or other device. PIC had employee test sanitizer during inspection.
